notes: All dates have been seen in prior research; retrospective evaluation, not a new blind test.
Select group hyperparameters on the first three validation months only; calibrate return magnitude on the last three, with disjoint H20-purged boundaries.
Return calibration uses an earlier checkpoint that has never fitted calibration labels; final checkpoint can use labels available before the evaluated half-year.
Fixed 30/40/30 signal weights; no sign search or redistribution. All policies use the same nested base forecasts.
Nonnegative return slope, clipped and shrunk; cash permitted, no leverage or short selling.
Net-edge objective subtracts immediate one-way turnover cost plus a conservative future liquidation cost, using H5 expected returns and known-close H5 covariance.
Cash return is zero; equal-weight timing benchmark separates timing from stock selection. No automatic paper or live trading.
